scenes.title: 3 things to know before buying Berny
scenes.say: Thinking about a Berny watch? Three things to know first.

scenes.title: Real movements, low prices
scenes.say: One. The good part. The AM339M diver has a Miyota automatic movement, sapphire crystal and two hundred meters of water resistance for one thirty nine ninety nine.

scenes.title: 24 hours to report defects
scenes.say: Two. Read the return rules. Defects must be reported within twenty four hours of delivery. Change of mind returns are thirty days at your cost, and custom watches can't be returned.

scenes.title: Ignore the strike-through
scenes.say: Three. Ignore the crossed out prices, they look inflated. And buy only from bernywatch dot com or Berny's official marketplace stores, because fake sites exist.

scenes.title: Great value, check it on arrival
scenes.say: Lots of watch for the money, just inspect it the day it arrives. Use code GOODVICUA for ten percent off. Full review on WiseChoice K R dot com.
